item.title: MHS boys, girls win first rounds of Holiday Classic
item.description: By Pat Culverhouse Both Minden High teams advanced to the second round of the 34th annual MHS Brown Service Center Holiday Classic with convincing wins on Wednesday’s opening day. item.title: Minden Fire Department investigates suspicious ‘haze’ at local pharmacy
item.description: Minden firefighters were called to CVS Pharmacy on Homer Road around 5 p.m. Thursday to investigate a suspicious “haze” and odor. Fire Chief Brian Williams said firefighters were checking HVAC units on the roof of the building, but found no flames.
